## Testing

What ran, and what remains unverified.

## Risk

Blast radius if this is wrong, sensitive paths touched, important review findings declined.

## How to revert

The one step that undoes it, normally a revert of the merge commit.

## Nits kept

Optional. Nits left unfixed but worth tracking, one per line: `path` (`symbol`): what is wrong; why it was left open. Whoever merges posts them in the pinned nits issue.
